Connect AI agents, such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, to Voidhash over the Model Context
Protocol, so they can read and change your projects as you.

Usage:
  voidhash mcp <command> [flags]

Commands:
  install    Add the Voidhash MCP server to the AI agents on this computer.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash mcp <command> --help' for more about a command.
